title: Scaling Kubernetes to 7,500 nodes
summary: We’ve scaled Kubernetes clusters to 7,500 nodes, producing a scalable infrastructure for large models like GPT-3, CLIP, and DALL·E, but also for rapid small-scale iterative research such as Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models.
body: We’ve scaled Kubernetes clusters to 7,500 nodes, producing a scalable infrastructure for large models like GPT-3, CLIP, and DALL·E, but also for rapid small-scale iterative research such as Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布成功将Kubernetes集群规模扩展至7,500个节点，为GPT-3、CLIP和DALL·E等大规模模型的训练以及小规模迭代研究构建了高可扩展的基础设施。原始信息显示：We’ve scaled Kubernetes clusters to 7,500 nodes, producing a scalable infrastructure for large models like GPT-3, CLIP, and DALL·E, but also for rapid small-scale iterative research such as Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Scaling Kubernetes to 7,500 nodes”。其重要性主要体现在：文章记录了OpenAI将Kubernetes集群扩展至7500个节点的工程实践，对支撑大模型训练与推理基础设施具有标杆价值。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
